interface.title: CountKit review
interface.field: Microbiology / cell biology image analysis (colony and nucleus counting)
interface.stage_of_work: Quality control and manual correction of automated object counts, after batch counting and before analysis
interface.what_it_is_for: Go through a batch of counted agar-plate (or microscope) overlay images, add colonies the counter missed by clicking them, remove false hits by number, and save a corrected count for each image without recounting the batch.

data.note: The page opened on the pre-generated demo/plate_results: 20 synthetic E. coli agar plates (plate_001.png … plate_020.png) with automated counts from 16 to 271. The same review page also serves cell/nucleus results, but the synthetic nuclei set (demo/cells_results) only loads if the server is restarted with a different path, so it was not reviewed. Saving writes corrections.json and counts_corrected.csv on the server. Nothing downloads to the browser, and the CSV is not served at /app/static/ (screens/050.webp). According to the reviewer's reading of the code (not seen in the browser), counts_corrected.csv adds corrected_count and reviewed columns, and reviewed is set to True for every image visited before saving, even with no edits (setdefault at review_app.py:51), not only for edited images.

screens_never_reached: Synthetic nuclei (cells) review: the same page serves it, but it needs a server restart with demo/cells_results as the results path, which cannot be done from the browser

The side-panel 'Flags: …' warning: per the reviewer's reading of review_app.py:90-91 it appears when counts.csv lists flags (crowded_plate, low_count, many_clumps, large_blob_removed, no_plate_found). None of the plates opened showed one, apparently because the demo plates carry no flags, so it was never seen. The only image-level note seen was the 'clumps: N' overlay header (plate_020)
Viewing or downloading the saved counts_corrected.csv / corrections.json: they are written to server disk only; there is no download button and /app/static/ did not serve them (screens/050.webp)
not_done: Check which images are flagged as crowded or low-count: only reached in part. The overlay header shows 'clumps: 1' on plate_020, but no 'Flags: …' warning appeared on any plate opened (e.g. plate_006 has only 16 colonies and shows none, screens/008.webp). The reviewer reports the code shows this warning when counts.csv lists flags, so the demo plates most likely just had none.

Could not read the saved counts_corrected.csv or corrections.json to confirm their contents, because nothing downloads to the browser. Per the reviewer's code reading, the CSV gets corrected_count and reviewed columns, and reviewed=True is set for every image visited before saving (setdefault at review_app.py:51), so plates only passed through in this run may also be marked reviewed.
Did not visit all 20 plates. About 9 were opened (001, 002, 005, 006, 009, 017, 019, 020; 010 only passed through briefly).

Did not find a real dust, printed-text or glare false positive in the demo. The 'E.coli 1e-4' label lies outside the blue counting circle and is not counted, so removal was tried on ordinary colony numbers.

Observed behaviour: when a number is taken out of the Remove list (chip × or clear-all), the count updates right away but the overlay keeps the old red ✕ marks until the next redraw, such as Save (screens/019.webp, screens/048.webp vs screens/021.webp, screens/049.webp).
Observed in the replay: pressing Enter after typing in Remove objects picks 'Select N matches' and removes every matching number, not just the one typed.
Left saved corrections on the server: plate_006 (one point added, object 2 removed), plate_001 (one point added, object 1 removed), plate_020 (one point added on the clump).
